tasks.short: Gather diagnostic data from case records, observations and interviews.

steps.what: Locate and read relevant case documentation in the clinical record
Observe client responses and interview clients or family about diagnostic concerns
Enter and check source attribution and actual observations in the assessment record
Save the checked assessment entry in the correct client record

tasks.design: Configure the {OTHER} clinical record to show relevant existing documents together. The therapist still reads, observes, interviews and records the actual evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant documents occupy separate record tabs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved views may reduce navigation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise nonverbal distress and contextual ambiguity.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical record views can reduce navigation without replacing source reading.

assumptions: Boundary is diagnostic gathering and its actual assessment entry. Case authors supply client ID, date, author and source text. Therapist captures actual observations and attribution in s3; missing metadata require manual navigation and reading.

Native configuration first. Existing configured views earn zero. Shares provisional, not measured. One-percent save is fully retained schema granularity. s3 includes the ordinary accuracy check, no extra approval meeting.
research_questions: Does a native view reduce navigation while retaining source reading?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked assessment entry and client destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional20 units at75 remaining saves5 minus0.5 upkeep=4.5. Half eligible navigation gives2 net. Observation, interviews, writing and save unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Structure music therapy sessions around treatment goals, pacing and transitions.

steps.what: Review treatment goals and recent responses in the clinical record
Choose music activities, transitions, intensity and sequencing for this client
Write and check timings, transitions, sequence and contingency cues in the session plan

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} session template for activities, timings, transitions and contingency cues. The therapist chooses and checks every activity against the actual treatment plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated session layout consumes part of planning time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates retain a reusable plan structure.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing energy and intensity appropriate to the client.
tasks.human_edge: Anticipate how musical transitions affect engagement and tolerance.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates reduce repeated layout without selecting clinical activities.

assumptions: Boundary is planning, not therapy delivery. Therapist reads actual goals and responses in s1 and produces activities, order, duration, transitions and contingencies in s2-s3. Missing or unsuitable fields are written manually.

Native first. Saving conditional on an actual written plan and repeated formatting today; an existing template earns zero. Provisional shares, one-percent save fully retained. Checking is ordinary plan writing, not an added approval ceremony.
unknowns: Existing templates and actual formatting effort
research_questions: How much plan writing is repeated layout?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional29 writing units reduced20 percent saves5.8 minus0.5 upkeep=5.3. Half eligible layout gives2.4. Clinical selection, review and save remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Attend continuing education and engage with demonstrations, practice and discussion
Check participation evidence and enter required personal learning record fields
Save the checked actual learning entry

tasks.design: Retain actual education participation and use the existing native {LMS} completion form for any required personal record. Existing form runtime creates no new labour saving.
tasks.enabler_now: No new change beyond existing completion capture is justified.
tasks.human_edge: Reflect on learning and adapt it responsibly to clients.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in participation or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: learning systems have native completion records while participation remains learner work.

assumptions: Boundary is continuing education and its required personal completion entry, not course organisation. Provider supplies course title, date and actual evidence; therapist verifies and enters missing fields in s2. Completion follows actual s1 participation.
Native form already suitable. No duplicate system entry or recurring course-search baseline established. Provisional shares; save1 fully retained. No new configuration means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is duplicate completion entry actually present?

incremental.description: No new configuration; existing native completion form retained

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked learning entry and actual evidence

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All95 participation,4 evidence and entry,1 save units retained. No new change or upkeep; native runtime is not labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate client assessment findings and recommendations in suitable forms.

steps.what: Check actual conclusions, recipient needs and permission to disclose
Write and check the actual assessment summary, recommendations and recipient details
Send the checked assessment communication to the authorised recipient
Explain findings orally and answer questions about actual recommendations
File the exact delivered assessment communication in the client record

tasks.design: Configure a native {DOCS} template for actual assessment findings and recommendations. Retain clinical wording and checks, separate authorised send and exact-version filing, and human oral explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates retain headings and disclosure fields.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining limitations in language the recipient understands.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt explanation to the client and audience.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native templates reduce repeated document layout while leaving conclusions and audience adaptation to the therapist.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual written communication accompanied by explanation; this provisional mode mix is not measured. Oral-only cases have no invented report. Therapist produces findings, recommendations, recipient and permission checks in s1-s2; missing fields are supplied manually.

Native template first; existing templates earn zero. Ordinary accuracy and recipient checking stays inside writing, no added approval ritual. Send and filing each retain provisional1 percent with no click saving. No extra discussion note assumed.
unknowns: Mode mix and repeated layout effort
research_questions: Can native templates reduce layout without weakening disclosure checks?

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked final assessment communication and authorised recipient
s2 checked final assessment communication unchanged as delivered in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional40 writing units reduced15 percent saves6 minus0.5 upkeep=5.5. Half eligible written layout gives2.5. Clinical conclusions, conversation, permission checking, send and filing unchanged.

role.altitude: Small reductions in navigation and repeated document layout; clinical interaction and musical judgement remain human.
skills_to_grow: Check source attribution and disclosure scope
role.ambitious_version: A therapist with clear plans and findings while preserving responsive human therapy.
